Motorbike Universal Mini LED Indicator & Number Plate Light – Super Bright 12V 1W Aluminum Waterproof Signal Lamp – Long-Lasting, Energy-Efficient Motorcycle & Car Lighting Accessory

Upgrade your ride’s visibility and safety with the New Design Universal Mini Indicator & Number Plate Light – a compact yet powerful LED solution for motorcycles and cars. Designed with precision, this durable accessory provides super-bright illumination that ensures maximum visibility on the road, both day and night.

Made with high-quality aluminum housing, it offers long-lasting performance with low power consumption, making it an energy-efficient choice for all riders. The universal compatibility allows it to function either as a motorcycle indicator light or as a car number plate light, giving you flexibility and style in one product.

With its easy 2-wire connection system, installation is quick and hassle-free. The 6000–7000K color temperature produces a crisp, modern white light that not only improves road safety but also enhances the overall aesthetic of your vehicle.

 Key Features:

Super Bright LED Light – Provides maximum visibility and safety on the road
Durable Aluminum Build – Strong, lightweight, and long-lasting design
Energy-Efficient – 1W low power consumption with high brightness output
Universal Fit – Suitable for motorcycles and cars (indicator or number plate light)
Modern White Glow (6000–7000K) – Stylish, clear, and safe illumination
Easy Installation – Simple 2-wire connection for quick setup

 Specifications:

Color Temperature: 6000–7000K
Connection: 2-wire system
Compatibility: Universal (motorcycles & cars)

 Perfect For:

Car number plate lighting
Custom modifications & styling upgrades
Riders looking for safety + modern design
